experiment: E4 — first real measurement: does the judge measure the leaning people already agree on?
written_at: 2026-10-11T14:10:00Z, before any measurement call (judge prompt v3, gpt-5.4-mini)

allsides.source: AllSides Media Bias Ratings (2024 chart and outlet pages), retrieved 2026-10-11; Left=-2, Lean Left=-1, Center=0, Lean Right=1, Right=2

contrast_rule: first outlet further toward + (economic RIGHT / CONSERVATIVE) than the second. From the posterior: confirmed if P(first > second) > 0.8, contradicted if < 0.2, else undecided (too little data). Finland left out: no consensus contrast.

hypotheses_and_targets.H_allsides: Spearman between AllSides and our SOCIAL position for the 14 rated outlets >= 0.6 (primary). Secondary, reported but not tested: econ axis, and the mean of both.
hypotheses_and_targets.H_contrasts: >= 80 % of DECIDED contrasts confirmed (one-sided sign test reported).
hypotheses_and_targets.H_split_half: Two random halves of the US/UK judgments (by call, seed 0): Spearman of the 16 US/UK outlets' social positions >= 0.7.
hypotheses_and_targets.H_nano: gpt-5.4-nano agrees with gpt-5.4-mini on the same 40 pairs (same order and question) at least as often as mini agrees with itself on a retest minus 0.10 (mini retest 2026-10-11: 0.80 econ / 0.78 social).

also_reported: judge order bias beta per axis
decided_in_advance: Spend the full budget even if early checks look bad (Axel). No claims from this experiment (pipeline phase); it validates the instrument.
